points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 徐悲鸿出生于江苏省宜兴县的一个书香门第，原名徐寿康。自幼受父亲影响，学习传统书画。9岁起随父亲读书，13岁时父亲去世，家庭经济困难。1912年，17岁的徐悲鸿开始在宜兴女子师范学校担任图画教师，开始了他的艺术教育生涯。这段时期他主要学习中国传统绘画技法，同时也接触西方绘画，为他后来的艺术道路奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Xu Beihong was born into a scholarly family in Yixing County, Jiangsu Province, originally named Xu Shoukang. Influenced by his father from an early age, he studied traditional Chinese painting and calligraphy. At age 9, he began studying with his father, and after his father's death when he was 13, the family faced financial difficulties. In 1912, at age 17, Xu started working as an art teacher at the Yixing Girls' Normal School, beginning his career in art education. During this period, he primarily studied traditional Chinese painting techniques while also being exposed to Western painting, laying the foundation for his future artistic path.

points.title: 沪上求艺
points.description: 1916年，徐悲鸿考入震旦大学学习法语，同时在上海画坛崭露头角。他结识了康有为、刘海粟等著名艺术家，受到康有为'中学为体，西学为用'思想的影响。1917年，他在上海举办首次个人画展，展出《马》等作品，引起艺术界关注。这一时期，他开始探索将中国传统绘画与西方写实主义相结合的艺术道路，创作了《田横五百士》等早期代表作，奠定了他在中国现代美术史上的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1916, Xu Beihong enrolled in Aurora University to study French while also making a name for himself in the Shanghai art scene. He met renowned artists such as Kang Youwei and Liu Haisui, and was influenced by Kang's philosophy of 'using Chinese learning as the foundation and Western learning for application.' In 1917, he held his first solo exhibition in Shanghai, featuring works like 'Horses,' which attracted attention from the art community. During this period, he began exploring the integration of traditional Chinese painting with Western realism, creating early representative works like 'The Five Hundred Loyalists of Tianheng,' establishing his significant position in the history of modern Chinese art.

points.title: 留学法国
points.description: 1919年，在康有为的推荐下，徐悲鸿获得官费赴法国留学的机会，进入巴黎高等美术学校学习。在法期间，他系统学习了西方写实主义绘画技法，深入研究达·芬奇、米开朗基罗等大师的作品。1921年，他赴德国柏林学习，进一步拓展艺术视野。1927年，徐悲鸿完成学业后回国，带回了大量西方艺术资料和作品。这段留学经历使他的艺术风格发生了根本性转变，从中国传统绘画转向中西融合的写实主义，为他后来推动中国美术教育改革奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1919, with a recommendation from Kang Youwei, Xu Beihong received a government scholarship to study in France, entering the École des Beaux-Arts in Paris. During his time in France, he systematically studied Western realistic painting techniques and conducted in-depth research on the works of masters such as Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo. In 1921, he traveled to Berlin, Germany to further expand his artistic horizons. After completing his studies in 1927, Xu returned to China with a large collection of Western art materials and works. This study abroad experience fundamentally transformed his artistic style, shifting from traditional Chinese painting to a fusion of Chinese and Western realism, laying the foundation for his later efforts to reform Chinese art education.

points.title: 教育改革
points.description: 1928年，徐悲鸿应蔡元培邀请，任国立中央大学艺术系教授，开始了他的美术教育改革实践。他提出'素描为一切造型艺术之基础'的教学理念，强调写实主义在中国美术教育中的重要性。1933年，他在南京举办个人画展，展出《愚公移山》等代表作，引起轰动。这一时期，他还创作了《田横五百士》、《九方皋》等重要作品，将西方写实技法与中国传统题材相结合。同时，他积极参与美术教育改革，培养了一批优秀学生，如吴作人、李可染等，对中国现代美术教育产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1928, at the invitation of Cai Yuanpei, Xu Beihong became a professor at the Art Department of the National Central University, beginning his practice of art education reform. He proposed the educational philosophy that 'drawing is the foundation of all plastic arts,' emphasizing the importance of realism in Chinese art education. In 1933, he held a solo exhibition in Nanjing, featuring representative works like 'The Foolish Old Man Who Moved Mountains,' which caused a sensation. During this period, he also created important works such as 'The Five Hundred Loyalists of Tianheng' and 'Jiufang Gao,' combining Western realistic techniques with traditional Chinese themes. Meanwhile, he actively participated in art education reform, cultivating outstanding students like Wu Zuoren and Li Keran, exerting a profound influence on modern Chinese art education.

points.title: 抗战岁月
points.description: 抗日战争爆发后，徐悲鸿随中央大学迁至重庆。在艰苦的战争环境中，他创作了大量反映民族精神的作品，如《愚公移山》、《奔马》等，表达中国人民不屈不挠的抗争精神。1940年，他赴印度举办画展，宣传中国抗战，扩大了中国艺术在国际上的影响。这一时期，他还担任中国美术家协会理事，积极参与抗战文艺活动，用艺术为抗战服务。他的作品风格更加成熟，将中国传统笔墨与西方写实技法完美融合，形成了独特的艺术风格，成为中国现代美术的重要代表。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, Xu Beihong moved with the Central University to Chongqing. In the harsh wartime environment, he created numerous works reflecting the national spirit, such as 'The Foolish Old Man Who Moved Mountains' and 'Galloping Horses,' expressing the indomitable spirit of the Chinese people's resistance. In 1940, he traveled to India to hold an exhibition, promoting China's war resistance and expanding the international influence of Chinese art. During this period, he also served as a director of the Chinese Artists Association, actively participating in wartime cultural activities and using art to serve the war effort. His artistic style became more mature, perfectly blending traditional Chinese brushwork with Western realistic techniques, forming a unique artistic style that became an important representative of modern Chinese art.

points.title: 晚年成就
points.description: 1946年，徐悲鸿应邀担任北平艺术专科学校校长，致力于中国美术教育的改革与发展。他提出'新中国美术教育'理念，强调艺术为人民服务，培养了一批优秀美术人才。1949年后，他继续担任中央美术学院院长，参与新中国美术事业的建设。这一时期，他创作了《毛主席在延安》、《奔马》等代表作，将艺术创作与时代精神紧密结合。1953年，徐悲鸿在北京逝世，享年58岁。他一生致力于中国美术教育的改革与发展，推动了中国现代美术的发展，被誉为'中国现代美术教育的奠基人'，对中国美术事业产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1946, Xu Beihong was invited to serve as president of the Beiping Art Specialized School, dedicating himself to the reform and development of Chinese art education. He proposed the concept of 'New China Art Education,' emphasizing that art should serve the people and cultivating outstanding artistic talents. After 1949, he continued to serve as president of the Central Academy of Fine Arts, participating in the construction of New China's art cause. During this period, he created representative works such as 'Chairman Mao in Yan'an' and 'Galloping Horses,' closely integrating artistic creation with the spirit of the times. Xu Beihong passed away in Beijing in 1953 at the age of 58. Throughout his life, he was committed to the reform and development of Chinese art education, promoting the development of modern Chinese art, and is known as the 'founder of modern Chinese art education,' exerting a profound influence on China's art cause.

appraisal.zh: 徐悲鸿被公认为中国现代美术教育的奠基者，他将西方写实主义引入中国画教学，主张素描为造型艺术之基础，作品《愚公移山》《奔马》兼具艺术成就与民族精神，所培养的吴作人、李可染等亦成名家。另一种看法认为，他过分偏重写实而轻忽传统写意精神，借鉴西方有时失之生硬，其与国民党政府的密切关系也引发过质疑。这些争议折射出他在中西碰撞中探索的复杂性。
appraisal.en: Xu Beihong is widely recognized as the founder of modern Chinese art education, introducing Western realism into the teaching of Chinese painting and holding that drawing is the foundation of the plastic arts; works such as "The Foolish Old Man Who Moved Mountains" and "Galloping Horses" combine artistic achievement with national spirit, and his students Wu Zuoren and Li Keran became leading figures. Another view holds that his stress on realism slighted the expressive spirit of tradition, that his borrowing from Western art was sometimes rigid, and that his close ties to the Kuomintang drew questioning. These disputes reflect the complexity of his exploration amid the collision of Chinese and Western cultures.

supporter.zh: 徐悲鸿是中国现代美术教育的奠基人，他开创性地将西方写实主义与中国传统绘画相结合，开创了中国美术教育的新纪元。他提出的'素描为一切造型艺术之基础'的教学理念，至今仍是中国美术教育的重要指导思想。徐悲鸿的作品如《愚公移山》、《奔马》等，不仅艺术成就卓越，更蕴含着深厚的民族精神和文化内涵，激励了一代又一代中国人。他培养的学生如吴作人、李可染等，都成为中国美术界的杰出代表，为中国美术事业的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Xu Beihong is the founder of modern Chinese art education, who innovatively combined Western realism with traditional Chinese painting, creating a new era in Chinese art education. His teaching philosophy that 'drawing is the foundation of all plastic arts' remains an important guiding principle in Chinese art education today. His works such as 'The Foolish Old Man Who Moved Mountains' and 'Galloping Horses' not only demonstrate outstanding artistic achievement but also contain profound national spirit and cultural connotations, inspiring generations of Chinese people. His students like Wu Zuoren and Li Keran have become outstanding representatives in the Chinese art world, making indelible contributions to the development of China's art cause.

critic.zh: 徐悲鸿的艺术理念也存在一定局限性。他过分强调写实主义，对中国传统绘画中的写意精神有所忽视，导致中国美术教育一度过于偏重西方技法。此外，他在艺术创作中对西方艺术的借鉴有时显得生硬，未能完全消化吸收西方艺术的精髓。在政治立场上，徐悲鸿与国民党政府关系密切，新中国成立后虽然选择留在大陆，但其政治立场和艺术理念也受到一定质疑。这些争议反映了徐悲鸿在艺术探索中的复杂性和历史局限性。
critic.en: Xu Beihong's artistic philosophy also has certain limitations. He overemphasized realism, somewhat neglecting the expressive spirit in traditional Chinese painting, leading to a period where Chinese art education was overly focused on Western techniques. Additionally, his adaptation of Western art in his creative work sometimes appeared rigid, failing to fully digest the essence of Western art. In terms of political stance, Xu maintained close ties with the Kuomintang government. Although he chose to stay in mainland China after the founding of New China, his political position and artistic philosophy were subject to certain questioning. These controversies reflect the complexity and historical limitations in Xu Beihong's artistic exploration.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，徐悲鸿被公认为中国现代美术史上的重要人物，他的艺术成就和教育贡献得到了广泛认可。他的作品《奔马》已成为中国文化的重要符号，代表着中国人民不屈不挠的精神。徐悲鸿的艺术道路体现了20世纪中国知识分子在中西文化碰撞中的探索与思考，反映了中国美术从传统向现代转型的历史进程。他的教育理念和实践对中国美术教育产生了深远影响，至今仍是中国美术教育的重要参考。徐悲鸿的一生，是中国现代美术发展历程的缩影，也是中国文化现代化进程中的重要一环。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Xu Beihong is widely recognized as an important figure in the history of modern Chinese art, with his artistic achievements and educational contributions receiving broad recognition. His work 'Galloping Horses' has become an important symbol of Chinese culture, representing the indomitable spirit of the Chinese people. Xu Beihong's artistic path reflects the exploration and contemplation of Chinese intellectuals in the collision of Chinese and Western cultures in the 20th century, reflecting the historical process of Chinese art's transition from tradition to modernity. His educational philosophy and practice have had a profound impact on Chinese art education and remain an important reference today. Xu Beihong's life is a microcosm of the development of modern Chinese art and an important part of the process of China's cultural modernization.

self.en: The great way of art lies in realism.
